svg.title: MAP / FUEL / OIL PRESSURE

svg.aria-label: Big Brick ECU MAP fuel pressure oil pressure: independent analog signals, common five volt supply and sensor ground
svg.text: BIG BRICK ECU · THREE-WIRE ANALOG PRESSURE SENSORS
ACTUAL BIG BRICK 121-PIN CONNECTOR · FACE VIEW
SAME CONNECTION METHOD · SEPARATE PRESSURE CALIBRATION
MAP, fuel, and oil pressure each use a separate ECU analog voltage channel. 5 V and sensor ground are shared.
Plug-contact order is illustrative. Verify the exact sensor pinout, voltage range, and scaling from its own datasheet.
BIG BRICK ECU · THREE ANALOG PRESSURE SIGNALS
